sweeps.name: pipeline-batch
sweeps.narrative: Pipeline stages only pay once the batch cap is high enough to keep every stage busy, so pp should lose least at large max_num_seqs.

sweeps.name: dp-batch
sweeps.narrative: Data-parallel attention splits the batch across ranks, so the batch caps should bind later at tp4 dp4 than at tp8 dp2.

sweeps.name: moe-collective
sweeps.narrative: DeepEP backends should cost more as dp widens, and low-latency should fit only at small step budgets.

sweeps.name: eplb
sweeps.narrative: Redundant experts should cost a little memory and buy nothing on uniform synthetic routing.

sweeps.name: kv-capacity-pipeline
sweeps.narrative: Narrower tensor groups hold more weight per rank, so KV headroom should bind on 2-instance and deep-pp shapes, not on tp16.

sweeps.name: kv-capacity-dp
sweeps.narrative: Data-parallel ranks each replicate attention weights, so fp8 KV and memory utilization should matter more at tp4 dp4.

sweeps.name: cudagraph-pipeline
sweeps.narrative: Full graph capture should cut per-step launch cost on every cut, but only where the memory it reserves still fits.

sweeps.name: cudagraph-dp
sweeps.narrative: Graph capture should help the data-parallel shapes as much as the tensor-parallel ones, memory permitting.

sweeps.name: expert-parallel
sweeps.narrative: Sharding experts should beat replicating them at tp16, and matter less once pipeline stages already split the weights.

sweeps.name: disaggregated
sweeps.narrative: Splitting prefill from decode should help little on short chatbot prompts, since the KV handoff costs more than the interference it removes.

sweeps.name: pd-threshold
sweeps.narrative: Disaggregating only prompts above a few hundred tokens should keep short turns local and beat always-split.

objective: max output tok/s per GPU subject to the scenario's SLOs
